scope: Generation input only. No evaluator-hidden facts, expected answers, binding results, eligibility labels, adverse signatures or rubric notes included.
model_version_rule: Use the exact received MAIN_ONLY_R1 model bytes pinned per execution. The unchanged fixed prompt’s phrase sealed initial model means this received pre-response R1 baseline, with its initial-author version preserved separately; it does not authorize a new model revision.
operation_rule: Do not generate now. After explicit release, generate independently from each fixed prompt/model. Do not open evaluator bank, binding files or other owner responses for generation. Maintain post-MAIN17 hypothetical slice and mode; do not carry prior-case learning. Any private information displayed in a party prompt belongs only to its named character, not the whole group.

generation_identity_disambiguation.historical_prose_alias: Some quoted root prose uses model_generation MAIN_ONLY_R1 as an alias. It does not rename project generation V1, create Gen06 or imply project V2. Exact baseline bytes are preserved.

runtime_record_required: Record the actual exposed model identifier/reasoning settings if observable; otherwise UNKNOWN. Never claim source independence, human/native expertise or heldout predictive success. These fields implement the unchanged fixed prompt’s output contract; they add no desired answer or scenario fact.
